paragraphs: The X4 xDrive20i and xDrive30i are part of the current G02 generation, fitted from 2018 onward. Both variants use the B48 — a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine, part of BMW's modular B-series family that also underpins the B58 six-cylinder unit. The B48 is a widely used engine across BMW's current range, from the X1 and 3 Series through to the 4 Series and Z4.
about.boldParagraph: The X4 xDrive30i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
